description: Use when you want the raw profile fields of a name. To decide whether to trust an agent, use verify_agent instead. Free. Reads the agent profile attached to a vanity name: display name, operator, website, X handle, description, agent type/model and MCP endpoint, plus the current owner. Shown only while the address that set it still owns the name. Read-only.
name: get_agent_profile
title: Get an agent identity
